sa: तथा त्रिपथगा गङ्गा नदीनामग्रजा स्मृता। तथा सरोदपानानां सर्वेषां सागरोऽग्रजः॥
en: Ganga having three courses is said to be first-born of all rivers. Likewise, of all wells and reservoirs of waters, the ocean is said to be the first born.

sa: दृष्ट्वा महर्षयः सर्वे शिरोभिरवानिं गताः॥ विमुक्ताः सर्वपापेभ्यः क्षान्ता विगतकल्मषाः।
en: The great Rishis, seeing Mahadeva, bowed to him by touching the ground with their heads. Gifted with forgiving souls, they all became freed from every sin and thoroughly purified.

sa: तथा प्रयान्तं वार्ष्णेयं द्वारकां भरतर्षभाः। परिष्वज्य न्यवर्तन्त सानुयात्रा परंतपाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said, As he of Vrishni's family was going to Dwraka, those foremost princes of Bharata's race, those chastisers of enemies, embraced him and fell back with their attendants.

sa: जरासंधं तु राजानं निर्जित्य गिरिगह्वरे। सर्वपार्थिवरत्नाढ्यो भविष्यति स वीर्यवान्॥
en: That scion of Yadu's race will liberate many kings confined in the prison of the king of the Magadhas (Jarasandha) after defeating him in his capital buried among mountains.

sa: नहुषं पापकर्माणमैश्वर्यबलमोहितम्। यथा च रोचते तुभ्यं तथा कर्तास्म्यहं मुने॥
en: Indeed, I shall hurl down Nahusha today, that sinful man, who has, besides, been stupefied by lordship and power. I shall do this, if you like it, О ascetic.

sa: पुत्रमांसोपमं जानन् खादते योऽविचक्षणः। मांसं मोहसमायुक्तः पुरुषः सोऽधमः स्मृतः॥
en: The meat of other animals is like the flesh of one's son. That foolish person, stupefied by folly, who eats meat is considered as the vilest of human beings.

sa: समुदग्रध्वजान् दृष्ट्वा कपान् सर्वे द्विजातयः। व्यसृजन ज्वलितानग्नीन् कपानां प्राणनाशनान्॥
en: Seeing the Kapas advancing against them with the standard of their cars upraised, the Brahmanas immediately created certain fires for the destruction of the vital airs of the Kapas.

sa: ब्रह्मसृष्टा हव्यभुजः कपान् हत्वा सनातनाः। नभसीव यथाऽभ्राणि व्यराजन्त नराधिप॥
en: Having brought about the destruction of the Kapas, those eternal fires, created with the help of the Vedic Mantras, began to shine in the firmament like so many clouds.

sa: नियमांश्चोपवासांश्च सर्वेषा ब्रूहि पार्थिव। आप्नोति कां गतिं तात उपवासपरायणः॥
en: How have vows and fasts come to be observed by persons of all castes, O king? What is that end which one devoted to the observance of fasts, acquires?

sa: स राजा राजमार्गेण नृनारीसंकुलेन च। कथंचिनिर्ययौ धीमान् वेपमानः कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Endued with great intelligence, the old king, with joined hands, and trembling with weakness, passed with difficulty along the principal street which was crowded with persons of both sexes.

sa: स्मृताश्च वर्णाश्चत्वारः पञ्चमो नाधिगम्यते। हरेच्च दशमं भागं शूद्रापुत्रः पितुर्धनात्॥
en: It has said that there are only four castes and there is no fifth. The son by the Shudra wife shall take the tenth part of his father's wealth.

sa: ऋषि ऊचु: पिनाकिन् भगनेत्रन्ध सर्वलोकनमस्कृता माहात्म्यं वासुदेवस्य श्रोतुमिच्छामि शङ्कर॥
en: The Rishis said (O holder of Pinaka, O tearer of the eyes of Bhaga, O you adored of the entire universe, we wish to hear the glory of Vasudeva.

sa: कच्चिदेतत् त्वया पार्थ श्रुतमेकाग्रचेतसा। तदापि हि रथस्थस्त्वं श्रुतवानेतदेव हि॥
en: Have you heard this discourse, O son of Pritha, with mind directed solely to wards it? This you did hear on that occasion while you were on your car.

sa: गावो मामुपतिष्ठन्तु हेमशृङ्ग्यः पयोमुचः। सुरभ्यः सौरभेय्यश्च सरितः सागरं यथा॥
en: Let kine which give profuse milk and which have horns adorned with goldkine viz., that are Surabhis or the daughters of Surabhisapproach me even as rivers approach the ocean.

sa: सर्वकामसमायुक्तां काश्यपी यः प्रयच्छति। सर्वभूतानि मन्यन्ते मां ददातीति वासव॥
en: That person, O Vasava, who makes a gift of earth capable of satisfying every wish with fruition is considered as making a gift of every object in the world,

sa: चर्मवल्कलसंवासी सायं प्रातरुपस्पृशेत्। अरण्यगोचरो नित्यं न ग्रामं प्रविशेत् पुनः॥
en: Clad in animal skins or barks of trees, he should perform his ablutions morning and evening. Always living within the forest, he should never return to an inhabited placc.

sa: मृतकस्य तृतीयाहे ब्राह्मणो योऽन्नमश्नुते। स त्रिवेलं समुन्मज्य द्वादशाहेन शुध्यति॥
en: The Brahmana who takes food at the house of a dead person on the third day after the death, is purified by bathing three times daily for twelve days.

sa: कौमुदे तु विशेषेण शुक्लपक्षे नराधिप। वर्जयेन्मधुमांसानि धर्मो ह्यत्र विधीयते॥
en: In the light half of the month of Kartika in especial, one should abstain from honey and mcat. It has been ordained, that there is great merit in it.

sa: मूर्तिमन्ति च सामानि यजूंषि च सहस्रशः। ऋग्वेदश्चागमत् तत्र पदक्रमविभूषितः॥
en: All the Samans also and all the Yajushas, in thousands and in their embodied forms, came there. The Rig Veda also came there, adorned with the rules of orthoepy.

sa: तदिच्छामि गुणाश्रोतुं मांसस्याभक्षणे प्रभो। भक्षणे चैव ये दोषास्तांश्चैव पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: I wish therefore, O powerful one, to hear what the merits are of abstention from flesh and the sin about the eating of flesh, O chief of Bharata's race.

sa: तस्मिन् न्यस्ते मणौ वीरो जिष्णुरुज्जीवितः प्रभुः। चिरसुप्त इवोत्तस्थौ मृष्टलोहितलोचनः॥
en: After the gem had been placed on his breast, the heroic and powerful Jishnu become revived. Opening his red eyes, he rose up like one who had slept long.

sa: व्युत्क्रान्तधर्मं तमहं घर्षणामर्षितो भृशम्। अहिर्भवस्वेति रुषा शप्स्ये पापं द्विजदुहम्॥
en: Euraged at such an insult I shall today curse that sinful wretch, that enemy of the Brahmanas, who has transcended all restrains, saying, Be you metamorphosed into a snake.

sa: सर्वानर्थः कुले यत्र जायते पापपूरुषः। अकीर्ति जनयत्येव कीर्तिमन्तर्दधाति च॥
en: That family in which a sinful person is born becomes subject to every evil. Such a person brings about infamy, and all the good deeds of the family disappear.

sa: स्थावरेषु तु भावेषु तिर्यग्भावगतं तमः। राजसास्तु विवर्तन्ते स्नेहभावस्तु सात्त्विकः॥
en: Among immobile objects, the quality of Ignorance predominates. The qualities belonging to Darkness are those properties of their is which suffer constant changes. Their oleaginous qualities belong to Goodness.

sa: अपरे मानवा देवि प्रदानकृपणा द्विजैः। याचिता न प्रयच्छन्ति विद्यमानेऽष्यबुद्धयः॥
en: There are others, O goddess, who are incapable of making gifts, Gifted with small understandings. They cannot make gifts even when solicited by Brahmanas and possessed of immense riches.

sa: असुराणां पुराण्यासंस्त्रीणि वीर्यवतां दिवि। आयसं राजतं चैव सौवर्णमपि चापरम्॥
en: The Asuras gifted with great energy had formerly threc cities in the firmament. One of these had been, made of iron; one of silver; and the third of gold.

sa: निर्यासाः सल्लकीवा देवानां दयिताऽस्तु ते। गुग्गुलुः प्रवरस्तेषां सर्वेषामिति निश्चयः॥
en: All exudations except that of the Boswellia serrata are agreeable to the celestials. It is, however, certain that the best of all cxudations is that of the Balsamodendron Mukul.

sa: परिवादो द्विजातीनां न श्रोतव्यः कथंचन। आसीताधोमुखस्तूष्णीं समुत्थाय व्रजेच्च वा॥
en: One should never utter the dispraise or calumny of the Brahmanas. Where the dispraise of Brahmanas is uttered, one should sit with face hanging down or leave that place.

sa: सर्वमेवाथ विज्ञेयं चित्तं ज्ञानमवेक्षते। रेतः शरीरभृत्काये विज्ञाता तु शरीरभृत्॥
en: All objects of knowledge are Mind. Knowledge only perceives it. The Individual Soul, encased in subtle form, lives within the gross body that is produced by the vital seed,

sa: वरयस्व वरं देवि दातास्मीति पुरंदर।॥ वरेण भगवन् मह्यं कृतं लोकपितामह। एष एव वरो मेऽद्य यत् प्रीतोऽसि ममानघ।॥ तामेवं ब्रुवती देवीं सुरभिं त्रिदशेश्वर। प्रत्यब्रुवं यद् देवेन्द्र तन्निबोध शचीपते॥
en: Thus addressed by me, Surabhi answered me, saying, I have no need O grandfather of boons. O sinless one, that you have been pleased with me is a great boon to me. To the illustrious Surabhi, O chief of the celestials, who said so to me, O lord of Sachi, I answered thus, O goddess, I have been highly pleased with this your freedom from cupidity and desire, and with these penances of yours, O you of beautiful face. I therefore, grant you the boon of immortality.

sa: गवां मध्ये शुचिर्भूत्वा गोमती मनसा जपेत्। पूताभिरद्भिराचम्य शुचिर्भवति निर्मलः॥
en: Living in a pure state, in the midst of kine, one should mentally recite those sacred Mantras named Gomati, after touching pure water. By doing this, one becomes purified.

sa: ब्राह्मणान् स्वस्ति वाच्याथ हुत्वा चैव हुताशनम्॥२२ आयूंषि पाण्डुपुत्राणामाशंसत नराधिपः।
en: Making the usual gifts to the Brahmanas and making them utter benedictions, and pouring libations on the sacred fire, the old king prayed for long life to the Pandavas.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा विपुलं प्रीतो देवशर्मा महानृषिः। मुमोद स्वर्गमास्थाय सहभार्यः सशिष्यकः॥
en: Having said these words to Vipula, the great Rishi Devasharman, ascended to Heaven with his wife and his disciple and began to pass his time there in great happiness.

sa: यस्माच्छक्तेन ते कृष्ण न त्राताः कुरुपुङ्गवाः। सम्बन्धिनः प्रियास्तस्माच्छप्स्येऽहं त्वामसंशयम्॥
en: Since, though able, O Krishna, you did not rescue those foremost ones of Kuru's race, who were your relatives and, therefore, dear to you, I shall, forsooth, curse you.

sa: वाग्बुद्धिपाणिपादैश्च व्यपेतस्य विपश्चितः। किं हास्यति मनुष्यस्य मन्दस्यापि हि जीवतः॥
en: Learned or ignorant (in a previous existence) the creature that is in this life, shorn of speech and understanding and hands and feet, is really shorn of everything. or

sa: स तथेति प्रतिश्रुत्य कीटो वर्त्मन्यतिष्ठत। शकटो व्रजंश्च सुमहानागतश्च यदृच्छया॥
en: Agreeing to the words of Vyasa, the worm did not leave the road, but remained on it. Meanwhile, the large car which was coming ini that direction came there.

sa: तस्मिन्ननिर्जिते युद्धे कामवस्थां गमिष्यसि। एतज्ज्ञात्वा तु कौन्तेय कृतकृत्यो भविष्यसि॥
en: And if defeated in this struggle, you shall find yourself in the most wretched condition, and, O son of Kunti, knowing this, and acting accordingly, shall you attain success.

sa: त्वया चायं नरव्याघ्र गुरुशुश्रूषयाऽनघा आराधितः सभृत्येन गान्धारी च यशस्विनी॥
en: Yourself also, O king, with your servants, O sinless one, have worshipped this king and the famous Gandhari with that ready obedience which a disciple pays to his preceptor.

sa: अयं मुनिगणः सर्वस्तपस्तेप इति प्रभो। तपोवेषकरो लोके भ्रमते विविधाकृतिः॥
en: These ascetics, O powerful lords, have practised various kinds of austerities. In the world are seen ascetics wandering everywhere under various forms and clad in various kinds of dress.

sa: नाभागधेयः पुरुषः कश्चिदेवंविधान् गुरून्। लभते व्यसनं प्राप्य सुहृदः साधुसम्मतान्॥
en: No unlucky man in times of great sorrow and distress, has ever the good fortune to secure the services of such preceptors and friends approved of all virtuous men.

sa: तयोस्तु प्रेक्षतोरेव भार्गवाणां कुलोद्वहः। अन्तर्हितोऽभूद् राजेन्द्र ततो राजापतत् क्षितौ॥
en: Proceeding a little way, the son of Bhrigu disappeared in the very sight of the royal pair. At this, the king struck with grief, drooped down on the Earth.

sa: स वारणं नगप्रख्यं प्रभिन्नकरटामुखम्। प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धः श्वेताश्वं प्रति पार्थिवः॥
en: The enraged prince then urged towards Arjuna that elephant of his, which resembled a veritable mountain, and from whose temples and mouth came out streams of juice showing excitement.

sa: स नृत्यन्निव नागेन्द्रो वज्रदत्तप्रचोदितः। आससाद द्रुतं राजन् कौरवाणां महारथम्॥
en: Indeed urged on by Vajradatta that prince of elephants quickly moved towards the powerful car-warrior of the Kurus, with the tread of one that seemed to dance in excitement.

sa: प्रयागे देवजयने देवारण्येषु चैव ह। भोगवत्यां महाराज कौशिकस्याश्रमे तथा॥
en: And to Prayaga, the sacrificial spot of the gods, and to the forest sacred to the gods and to Bhogavati, O monarch, as also to the hermitage of Kaushika,

sa: द्विधाभूत इवादित्य उदये प्रत्यदृश्यत! ज्वलन्त्या शिखया भूयो भानुमानुदितो रविः॥
en: When the sun rose, he appeared as if he had been divided into two parts. When that luminary rose in the sky he appeared to blaze forth in flames.

sa: कथमिन्दीवरश्यामं सुदंष्ट्रं चारुलोचनम्। मुखं ते दृश्यते वत्स गुण्ठितं रणरेणुना॥
en: Oh my dear child, how shall I see your face dark like the blue lotus and graced with beautiful teeth and charming eyes, soiled with the dust of battle-field!

sa: चुक्षुभुश्च महाराज सागरा मकरालयाः। प्रतिस्रोतः प्रवृत्ताश्च तथा गन्तुं समुद्रगाः॥
en: 0 mighty monarch, the oceans, the abode of the numerous acquatic creatures, became agitated; and the ocean-going rivers began to flow in directions opposite to their natural was courses.

sa: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो वयोवृद्धश्च भारत। प्रणष्टसंज्ञः सहसा रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्॥
en: Thus deeply pierced and overwhelmed with pain, the preceptor worn out as he was with age, squatted down on the terrace of his chariot being deprived of his consciousness.

sa: देहि दानं द्विजातिभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च यथोचितम्॥ क्लिष्टाया वर्षपूगांश्च मातुर्मातृहिते स्थितः।
en: Make gifts to the twice-born and due offerings to your forefathers. Seeking the welfare of your mother, that mother who has undergone much trouble for a series of years.

sa: विकर्ण दशभिर्बाणैः पञ्चभिश्च जयद्रथम्॥ विद्ध्वा भीमोऽनदद्धृष्टः सैन्धवं च पुनस्त्रिभिः।
en: Then Bhima having pierced Vikarna with ten arrows and the ruler of the Sindhus with five, roared out in delight; and then again he pierced Jayadratha with three arrows.

sa: पृथिवी निर्भया देव त्वत्प्रसादात् सदाऽभवत्। तस्माद् भव विशालाक्ष यदुवंशविवर्धनः॥
en: O god, through your grace the earth have ever been freed from all her apprehensions. So, O you of expanded eyes, be you the propagator of the Yadu race.

sa: दीर्यमाणां चमू दृष्ट्वा भगदत्तेन मारिष। आहूयमानस्य च तैरभवद्धृदयं द्विधा॥
en: Beholding then the ranks of his own army broken by Bhagadatta and Osire, being summoned the other-hand by by the Samshaptakas, Arjuna was scen divided in his heart (purpose).

sa: निगृह्यमाणश्च तदाऽऽदिदेवो भृशं सरोषः किल चात्मयोगी। र्जिष्णु महावात इवैकवृक्षम्।।१००।
en: That first of all gods, Krishna was excited with rage. Therefore, though thus seized, Vishnu (Krishna) forcibly dragged Vishnu (Arjuna) after him, like a tempest carrying away a tree.

sa: स्वधर्मपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि। धाद्धि युद्धाच्छ्रेयोऽन्यत् क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते॥
en: (And again) loO king to your own duty pertaining to your caste, you ought not to waver; for there is nothing better for a Kshatriya than a righteous battle.

sa: दैववाक्यात् प्रचिच्छेद शरेण भृशमर्जुनः। छिन्नमात्रेऽशुके तस्मिन् रुद्धनेत्रो बभूव सः॥
en: In compliance with the direction, Arjuna took out crescent shaped arrow of straight knots and shot at the eyes of Bhagadatta. He thus, lost his eyes and became blind.

sa: यश्च हेतुरवध्यत्वे तेषामक्लिष्टकर्मणाम्। तं शृणुष्व महाबाहो मम कीर्तयतः प्रभो॥
en: Hear from me as I speak, O king, O lord, the reason why those sons of Pandu who are never tired in the performance of pious acts, are unslayable.

sa: रात्रिः समभवत् तत्र नापश्याम ततोऽनुगान्। ततोऽवहारं सैन्यानां प्रचक्रुः कुरुपाण्डवाः॥
en: The hideous pall of night fell over the earth and the fight could no longer be discerned. Then the Kurus and the Pandavas withdrew their forces from the field.

sa: भयार्ताः प्रपलायन्ते सिंहात् क्षुद्रमृगा इव। एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच वासुदेवं धनंजयः॥ नोदयाश्वान् यतो भीष्मो विगाहैतद् बलार्णवम्। पातयिष्यामि दुर्धर्षं वृद्धं कुरुपितामहम्॥
en: Having been afflicted with fear, they are running away, as do the small animals at the sight of the lion". Having been thus addressed, Dhananjaya thus spoke to Vasudeva. "Plunging through this sea of the hostile army, drive the horses to the spot where Bhishma is. I shall fell down (today) that invincible warriors, the revered Kuru grandsire.

sa: तौ युध्यमानौ समरे भृशमन्योन्यविक्षतौ। पुत्रौ ते देवसंकाशौ व्यरोचेतां महाबलौ॥
en: Thus fighting with each other and mangling each other (with shafts) in that battle, those two sons of yours, both endued with great prowess appeared beautiful like two gods.

sa: शिखण्डिनमथो ब्रूहि उलूक वचनान्मम। स्त्रीति मत्वा महाबाहुर्न हनिष्यति कौरवः॥
en: That son of Ganga, that foremost among bow men, will not kill you therefore, do you fight without fear; fight with all your might, I will see your manliness."

sa: हनिष्यामि रणे भीष्ममाहूय पुरुषर्षभम्। पश्यतां धार्तराष्ट्राणां यदि नेच्छति फाल्गुनः॥
en: Summoning that foremost of men Bhishma in battle, I will slay him, even before the very eyes of the Dhritarashtra's troops, if indeed Arjuna desists from slaying the former.

sa: तमेकं समरे शूरं पाण्डवाः सुंजयैः सह। अनेकशतसाहस्रं समपश्यन्त लाघवात्॥
en: In consequence of his great lightness of hands, the Pandavas and the Srinjayas saw that hero in that battle multiplied to one thousand fold, though he was really alone.

sa: शृङ्गवांस्तु महाराज देवानां प्रतिसंचरः॥ इत्येतानि महाराज सप्त वर्षाणि भागशः।
en: The mountain of Shringavat is considered to be the resort of the celestial. O king of kings, these are the seven Varshas of the world as they are divided.

sa: न वेद कृष्णं दाशार्हमर्जुनं चैव पाण्डवम्। पूर्वदेवी महात्मानौ नरनारायणावुभौ॥
en: Duryodhana knows not Krishna of the Dasharha race and Arjuna the son of Pandu; they both are supreme divinities, of high soul, know on earth as Nara and Narayana.

sa: अथ तौ वध्यमानौ तु द्रोणेन रथसत्तमौ। आवर्जयेतां दुर्धर्षे युगान्ताग्निमिवोत्थितम्॥
en: Thus afflicted by Drona, those two foremost of car-warriors (Krishna and Arjuna) shunned him who then resembled the irresistibly raging conflagration that appears at the end of every Yuga.

sa: तथैव तावकं सैन्यं भीमार्जुनपरिक्षतम्। मुह्यते तत्र तत्रैव समदेव वराङ्गना॥
en: So also your soldiers, mangled by Bhima and Arjuna, were deprived of their senses even where they stood, like an excellent damsel fainting away in consequence of wounded pride.

sa: उपाशाम्यद्रजो भौमं भीरून् कश्मलमाविशत्। चक्रेण चक्रमासाद्य वीरो वीरस्य संयुगे॥
en: In that fight one hero having his car-wheel entangled with that of another and being too near to use any other weapon, smashed the other's head with a mace.

sa: अयं स मामभिप्राप्तो वर्षपूगाभिचिन्तितः। पाण्डवानां ससैन्यानां कुरूणां च समागमः॥
en: What I have been thinking for many years has now come to me; namely the meeting of the Pandavas and the Kurus at the head of their respective armies.

sa: अपरोक्षं च विद्यासु व्यायामे च कृतश्रमम्। शस्त्रग्रहणविद्यासु सर्वासु परिनिष्ठितम्॥
en: They are well disciplined in the exercise of all kinds of weapons, and are experts in mounting on and descending from vehicles, in moving forward and in falling back,

sa: द्विरंशे पिप्पलस्तत्र द्विरंशे च शशो महान्। सर्वौषधिसमावायः सर्वतः परिवारितः॥
en: Two of its parts appear like a pipal tree, the two others look like a large hare. It is surrounded on all sides with the various kinds of plants.

sa: सर्वास्त्रविदमेयात्मा वारयामास फाल्गुनिः। हतमायं ततो रक्षो वध्यमानं च सायकैः॥
en: But Phalguna's son, of immeasurable should, and versed in the use of all weapons, destroyed them all. Then the Rakshasas, his illusions all neutralised, and himself afflicted with shafts,

sa: त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः। कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किंचित् करोति सः॥
en: Getting rid of the attachment (desire) for the fruits of actions, being ever contented, and depending on none, although (such men) engages in action, they do nothing at all.

sa: मारुतेनेव महता मेघानीकं व्यदीर्यत। प्रकाल्यमानं तत् सैन्यं नाशकत् प्रतिवीक्षितुम्॥
en: Like the tempest scattering and tearing a mass of cloud, Arjuna then routed your army; when he was thus afflicting the army, none could turn his eyes towards him.

sa: नाशयन्तीव मे प्राणान् यमदूता इवाहिताः॥ गदापरिघसंस्पर्शा नेमे बाणाः शिखण्डिनः।
en: Of touch heavy like that of a mace or a bludgeon these arrows are destroying my vital breaths like so many messengers of Death. Surely they are not Shikhandin's.

sa: संधाय च शितं बाणं कालाग्निसमतेजसम्। मुमोज परमक्रुद्धस्तस्मिन् घोरे निशाचरे॥
en: Then placing on his bow string whetted shafts blazing like the Fire of dissolution, and highly excited with rage, he discharged them at that dreadful ranger of the night.

sa: त्वया झुक्ता गमिष्यामि धेनुकाश्रममुत्तमम्। तत्र तप्स्ये तपस्तीनं तवैवाराधने रता॥
en: Permitted by you, I shall go to the excellent hermitage of Dhenuka and there shall I practice ascetic austerities of the most severe sort, being engaged in worshipping yourself.

sa: बाध्यमानेषु सैन्येषु द्रोणपार्षतसायकैः। त्यक्त्वा प्राणान् परं शक्त्या युध्यन्ते सर्वतोमुखाः॥३३
en: When the troops were thus being slaughtered by the arrows of Drona and Prishata's son, all warriors, heedless of their lives, fought on putting forth all their best energies.

sa: ग्रामारण्यानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च। त्रातारः सिन्धुराजस्य भवन्ति मधुसूदन॥
en: The domestic and the wild animals and all the mobile and immobile beings united together-even if all these become the protector of the Sindhu king, O slayer of Madhu.

sa: तामस्य विशिखैश्छित्त्वा त्रिधा त्रिभिरपातयत्॥ पश्यतां कुरुवीराणां सर्वेषां तव भारत।
en: Thereupon with three arrows cutting that lance into three pierces Arjuna felied it down on the ground, O Bharata, even before the very eyes of all the Kurus heroes.

sa: मनसा विहते पुण्ये विस्तीर्णे नगरोपमे। दिव्याश्चयुजि संनद्धे काञ्चनेन विभूषिते॥
en: The car was created by his will force and was like a holy and spacious city with celestial horses yoked to it and well protected and ornamented with gold.

sa: द्रोणस्य रथघोषेण मौर्वीनिप्पेषणेन च। धनुः शब्देन चाकाशे शब्दः समभवन्महान्॥
en: A terrible sound caused by the rattle of Drona's chariot, by the contraction and stretching of his bow-string and by the twang of his bow, filled the conclave dome.

sa: तन्त्रीस्वनमुखं रम्यं पुंस्कोकिलसमध्वनिम्॥ अशृण्वतः स्वनं तस्य का शान्तिर्हृदयस्य मे।
en: Delightful like the warding of a lyre, charming and melodious like the voice of a cuckoo. Oh, without hearing that voice of his what peace can my heart enjoy?

sa: तापयामास च द्रौणि शैनेयः परवीरहा। विमुक्तो मेघजालेन यथैव तपनस्तथा॥
en: Then that grandson of Shini, freed from that net-work of arrows, like the sun emerging out of the clouds, began to scorch the son of Drona (with his arrows).

sa: सर्वे रक्तपताकाश्च सर्वे वै हेमालिनः । चन्दनागुरुदिग्घाङ्गाः स्रग्विणः सूक्ष्मवाससः॥
en: All of them possessed crimson flags, all had golden garlands; all were smeared with sandalpaste and other perfumed unguents and all of them wore floral garlands and fine attires.

sa: सहिताः पर्यधावन्त कार्णिं प्रति युयुत्सवः। तेषां दश सहस्राणि बभूबुदृढधन्विनाम्॥
en: In a serried file, they rushed against Krishna's nephew. desirous of fighting with him. All of them firm bowmen, then numbered no less then ten thousand strong in all.

sa: संजय उवाच प्रतिज्ञाते तु पार्थेन सिन्धुराजवधे तदा। वासुदेवो महाबाहुर्धनंजयमभाषत॥
en: Sanjaya said After the son of Pritha (Arjuna) had promised to slay the ruler of the Sindhus, the mighty-armed son of Vasudeva addressed him sayingभ्रातॄणां मतमज्ञाय त्वया वाचा प्रतिश्रुतम्।

sa: ननाद बलवन्नादं सौभद्रः परवीरहा। हताश्वात् तु रथात् तूर्णंसोऽवप्लुत्य महारथः॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior Chitrasena, jumping down with agility from the car of which the steeds were slain, ascended with quickness, O ruler of men, the chariot of Durmukha.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय पार्षतः परवीरहा। द्रोणं विव्याध विंशत्या रुक्मपुजैः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Thereafter, grasping another bow that slayer of hostile heroes, namely the son of Prishata, son pierced Drona with seventy shafts all furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone.

sa: निश्चरुरर्चिषश्चापात् खङ्गाश्च ज्वलिता भृशम्। व्यक्तं पश्यन्ति शस्त्राणि संग्रामं समुपस्थितम्॥
en: Rays of light are coming out from bows and swords produce great luster. It is evident these weapons see before them the battle as if it has already begun.

sa: स शराचितसर्वाङ्गः क्रुद्धः शक्रात्मजात्मजः। विचरन् ददृशे सैन्ये पाशहस्त इवान्तकः॥
en: Then that enraged grandson of Shakra, with his body struck all over with arrows. Looked, as he careered through the forces, like the destroyer himself with noose in hand.

sa: ज्याशब्दः शुश्रुवे तस्य तलशब्दश्च दारुणः। महाशनिमुचः काले पयोदस्येव निःस्वनः॥
en: Then, O Bharata, there were heard the twangs of his bow and the slapping of his palms, resembling the rumble of rain-clouds surcharged with the thunder during the rains.

sa: तद् युद्धमभवद् घोरं देवानां दानवैरिव। जयमाकाङ्क्षतां संख्ये यशश्च सुमहाद्भुतम्॥
en: Then a fierce and wonderful encounter, like that between the celestial and the Asuras, ensued between those two hosts each desirous of winning victory and great fame in battle.

sa: सनागस्यन्दनहयान् द्रक्ष्यध्वं निहतान् मया। संग्रामे सानुबन्धांस्तान् मम पुत्रस्य वैरिणः॥
en: You will see that, I will consume the enemy with their elephants, chariois and steeds in battle all those opponents of my son together with all their blood relations.

sa: अभीषुहस्तं कृष्णं च दृष्ट्वाऽऽदित्यमिवापरम्। मध्यंदिनगतं संख्ये न शेकुः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्॥
en: Beholding Krishna resembling another Aditya and holding the reins in his hands, look like the sun in the meridian, your soldiers were unable to fix their eyes on him.

sa: स पपात रणे तूर्णं भारद्वाजशराहतः। धनुस्त्यक्त्वा शरांश्चैव पितुरेव समीपतः॥
en: Pierced by the shaft of Bharadvaja's son, Sankha quickly dropped down from his car, loosing hold of his bow and arrows and before the very presence of his father.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे। ज्ञानविज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्॥
en: The great one said I shall now speak to you, O evilless one. all that mysterious knowledge, along with experience, by knowing which you will be freed from evil.

sa: दुर्योधनापराधेन शकुनेः सौबलस्य च। क्षत्रिया निधनं यान्ति कर्णदुर्मन्त्रितेन च॥
en: In consequence of the faults of Duryodhana and those of Shakuni the son of Subala, and in consequence of the wicked counsels of Karna, the Kshatriyas are suffering destruction.

sa: पुत्रैस्तव दुराधर्षो रक्षितः सुमहाबलैः। ततो द्रोणो महेष्वासः पुत्रश्चास्य महाबलः॥
en: That invincible warrior Bhishma, was protected by your sons, all endued with great might. Next behind him came the mighty bowman Drona along with his highly puissant son Ashvathama.

sa: गान्धारराजः शकुनिः प्राच्योदीच्याश्च सर्वशः। शकाः किराता यवनाः शिवयोऽथ वसातयः॥
en: And then the Gandharva king named Shakuni and all those who came from the east and north from all parts, and the Shakas, Kiratas, Yavanas, Shibis and the Vasatis,

sa: चेकितानस्तु वार्ष्णेयो गौतमं रथिनां वरम्। प्रेक्षतां सर्वसैन्यानां छादयामास सायकैः॥
en: Then Chekitana that descendant of the Vrishni race, covered that foremost of carwarriors namely the son of Gautami, with numerous arrows, before the very eyes of all the troops.

sa: दिष्ट्या कलिङ्गराजश्च राजपुत्रश्च केतुमान्। शक्रदेवश्च कालिङ्गः कलिङ्गाश्च मृधे हताः॥
en: By good luck the Kalinga king, also the Kalinga prince Ketumat and also Shakradeva of that country and also all the Kalingas have been killed, you in this battle.

sa: अयं स मामभिप्राप्तो वर्षपूगाभिचिन्तितः। पाण्डवानां ससैन्यानां कुरूणां च समागमः॥
en: What I have been thinking for many years has now come to me; namely the meeting of the Pandavas and the Kurus at the head of their respective armies.

sa: अनुज्ञातास्ततः सर्वे सुहृदो धर्मसूनुना। त्वरमाणा: सुसंनद्धा हृष्टा युद्धाय निर्ययुः॥
en: Then permitted by the son of Dharma, all the friends and partisans of the Pandavas, cheerfully set out for the battle with haste and with hearts swelling with rage.

sa: विदितं तात योगान्मे सर्वमेतत् तवेप्सितम्। तथा तद् भवितेत्युक्त्वा तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: “I have come to know, O sire, all that you desire, through my Yoga power. It will be even as you desire”. Saying this he disappeared then and there.

sa: सा तमासाद्य राजानं शाल्वं वचनमब्रवीत्। आगताऽहं महाबाहो त्वामुद्दिश्य महामते॥
en: She, going to the king of the “Shalvas, said these words:-"I have come, O you of long arms, expecting to be united with you, O you of great intelligence."

sa: सौभद्रेण हतैः पूर्वे सोत्तरायोधिभिर्द्विपैः। पाण्डूनां दर्शितः पन्थाः सैन्धवेन निवारितः॥
en: The track that the son of Subhadra bad marked out for the Pandavas by the numerous slain warriors and elephants, was then blockaded by the king of the Sindhus.

sa: अनिलेन यथाऽभ्राणि विच्छिन्नानि समन्ततः। तथा पार्थस्य सैन्यानिविच्छन्नानि क्वचित् क्वचित्॥३१
en: Just as masses of clouds are torn into pieces by the vehemence of the wind, so the army belonging to the son of Pritha was shattered at many places.

sa: तान् पश्यन् सैन्यमध्यस्थो राजा स्वजनसंवृतः। दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत् कर्णे प्रहृष्टः प्रहसन्निव॥
en: Beholding them (the routed army), king Duryodhana standing in the midst of his own troops and surrounded by his own kinsmen greatly delighted, smilingly said these words to Karna.

sa: सौभद्रेण हतैः पूर्वे सोत्तरायोधिभिर्द्विपैः। पाण्डूनां दर्शितः पन्थाः सैन्धवेन निवारितः॥
en: The track that the son of Subhadra bad marked out for the Pandavas by the numerous slain warriors and elephants, was then blockaded by the king of the Sindhus.

sa: जघान तानप्यथ पृष्ठगोपान्। रथांश्च तांस्तानवजित्य संख्ये धनंजयः प्रीतमना यशस्वी॥
en: With sixty shafts, cleansed with oil, slew all those warriors protecting the rear of the Trigarta king. Vanquishing those sixty carwarriors in battle, filled with delight, the illustrious Dhananjaya,

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु सैन्धवे भारमतिमात्रं समाहितम्। सैन्यं तव महाराज युधिष्ठिरमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Beholding a very heavy burden (of keeping the rest of the Pandavas at bay) placed on the shoulder of the Sindhu king, your troops, O mighty monarch, assailed Yudhishthira.

sa: आगमः क्रियतां व्यक्तः कुमारोऽयं सुतो मम। मिथ्यैतदुक्तं केनापि तदश्रद्धेयमित्युत॥
en: Make an enquiry and let this be made clear that this prince, is my son. You have been misinformation by some body; but this is surely unworthy of belief

sa: तव दिव्यानि चास्त्राणि विक्रमश्च परंतप। समागमश्च बहुभिः पुराभूदमरैः सह॥
en: Your weapons are of celestial make and o redresser of your foes, your prowess in divine. And before this, you have had encounters with many a host of Asuras.

sa: ततः सा चिन्तयामास मत्कृते दुःखितावुभौ। इमाविति ततश्चक्रे मतिं प्राणविनाशने।॥
en: Thereupon she thought (within herself), "these two (my father and mother) are afflicted with grief on my account.” Then she made up her mind for destroying her own life.

sa: एष योत्स्यति संग्रामे गजस्कन्धविशारदः। रथेन वा महाबाहुः क्षपयन् शत्रुवाहिनीम्॥
en: Conversant with the science of war. that one of long arms having the shoulders of an elephant will fight in battle scattering the hostile army, seated on a chariot.

sa: लब्धास्त्रश्चित्रयोधी च मनस्वी च दृढव्रतः। संस्मरन् वै परिक्लेशं स्वपितुर्विक्रमिष्यति॥
en: Quick in the use of arms, capable of using diverse weapons, spirited and of firm vows, he will show forth his prowess today remembering the sufferings of his father.

sa: युक्तं धारणया सम्यक् सतः केचिदुपासते। अभ्यस्यन्ति परं देवं विद्युत्संशब्दिताक्षरम्॥
en: Some adore Brahma in images. Some adore Him as devoid of qualities. Divinity which has been described to be like a flash of lightning and which is again indestructible.

sa: न मातृपुत्रबान्धवा न संस्तुतः प्रियो जनः। अनुव्रजन्ति संकटे व्रजन्तमेकपातिनम्॥
en: Neither mother, nor son, nor relatives, nor dear friends even when begged with honours, accompany the man that dies. One alone has to go to the regions of Yama.

sa: अत्रोच्यते तथा ह्येतद् वेद योगेश्वरो हरिः। तथैतदुपपन्नार्थं वर्णयन्ति महर्षयः॥
en: It is said that that master of Yoga, named Hari, perceives truly how it happens. The great Rishis say that the explanation given by Hari is correct and reasonable.

sa: प्रकीर्णमेषभारं हि यद्वद् धार्येत दस्युभिः। प्रतिलोमां दिशं बुद्ध्वा संसारमबुधास्तथा॥
en: Ignorant persons bearing the weight of the world are like robbers laden with their booty of straggling sheep. The latter always avoid roads which are not favourable to them,

sa: स्पर्शने त्वक् तथा वायुः प्राणापानव्यपाश्रयः। व्यानोदानौ समानश्च पञ्चधा देहयापनम्॥
en: From thoughts of touch it acquires the skin. Likewise, the five vital airs are acquired by it, viz., Prana, Apana, Vyana, Udana, and Samana, which make the body agoing.

sa: मम वै पितरं प्रीतः परमेष्ठ्यप्यजीजनत्। अहं संकल्पजस्तस्य पुत्रः प्रथमकल्पितः॥
en: That Brahman, otherwise called Prameshthi, filled with cheerfulness, caused my father (Daksha) to come into being. I was the son of Brahman, created before all others, by his will.

sa: आदर्श स्वामिव च्छायां पश्यस्यात्मानमात्मना। व्यस्यात्मनि स्वयं वेदान् बुद्ध्या समनुचिन्तय॥
en: You see now your Soul with your Soul as one sees his own shadow in a mirror. Staying yourself on your own Soul, do you reflect on the Vedas.

sa: सद्भिराचरितत्वात्तु वृत्तमेतदगर्हितम्। इयं सा बुद्धिरभ्येत्य यया याति परां गतिम्॥
en: Abstention of acts is observed by highly wise That conduct, therefore, is praiseworthy. The intelligence which advocates abstention from acts, is that by which one attains to liberation. men.

sa: जलविन्दुर्यथा लोल: पर्णस्थः सर्वतश्चलः। एवमेवास्य चित्तं च भवति ध्यानवर्त्मनि॥
en: As a drop of water on a leaf in unstable and moves about on all sides, so becomes the Yogin's mind when first fix on the path of meditation.

sa: साक्षिभूता महात्मानो भुवनानां प्रभावनाः। एवमेते महात्मानः स्थिताः प्रत्येकशो दिशम्॥
en: Those great ones are the witnesses of the universe, and the creators of all the worlds. Thus do they live in their respective quarters. unui anilda Bacall duur wordt

sa: सुसंस्कृतानि प्रयताः शुचीनि गुणवन्ति च। ददत्यन्नानि तृप्त्यर्थं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो युधिष्ठिर॥
en: My heart, O king, always yearns after them who, for the satisfaction of Brahmanas, O Yudhishthira, give to them, with devotion, food that is well-cooked and clean and wholesome.

sa: व्यभिचारे तु कस्मिश्चिद् व्यतिक्रम्यापरान् सुतान्। पित्रोक्तः कुपितेनाथ जहीमां जननीमिति॥
en: On a certain occasion, seeing an act of great fault in his wife, the father Gautama, passing over his other children commanded in anger this Chirakarin, saying,-kill this women!

sa: पुनः पुनरथोक्ता सा गतसत्त्वेव भामिनी। तूष्णीमासीत् ततो देवो देवानामीश्वरेश्वरः॥
en: Brahma addressed her again and again, but the lady appeared to be herself deprived of life. Seeing her thus, the god of gods, that lords of lords, became silent.

sa: सर्वाण्येतानि संवार्य द्वाराणि मनसि स्थितः। मनस्येकाग्रतां कृत्वा तत्परं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: Closing all the doors formed by the senses the Understanding should be with-drawn into the mind. In this condition when absorbed in contemplation, it acquires the knowledge of Brahma.

sa: शक्तेनापि समुद्धर्तुं कम्पिता साभवत् तदा॥ रक्षिता स्कन्दराजस्य धर्षणा प्रभविष्णुना।
en: Although Vishnu was fully capable to raise the dart, still he contented himself with only shaking it. In this, the powerful lord only kept the honour of Skanda intact.

sa: विभेम्यहमधर्मस्य धर्नामादिश कर्म मे। त्वं मां भीतामवेक्षस्व शिवेनेक्षस्व चक्षुषा॥
en: I fear to do any thing that is iniquitious! Do you find out a holy work for me. You see that I am frightened. Oh, look upon me mercifully.

sa: तपसैव ससर्जानं फलमूलानि यानि च। त्रील्लोकांस्तपसा सिद्धाः पश्यन्ति सुसमाहिताः॥
en: It was by the help of penances that the Grandfather created food, fruits and roots. It is one by penances that ascetics behold the three worlds, with enraptured souls.

sa: इष्टस्त्रिदशशार्दूल तत्र मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि। प्रणिपातेन तस्येन्द्रः परितुष्टो वरं ददौ॥
en: Which of your sons, O king, do you wish, should revive, those whom you gave birth to as a woman, or those who were begotten by you asa man.

sa: दस्यवश्चापि नैच्छन्त तमत्तुं पापकारिणम्। क्रव्यादा अपि राजेन्द्र कृतघ्नं नोपभुञ्जते॥
en: It so came about that even the very robbers refused to eat the flesh of that vile man. Though cannibals, O king, they would not eat an ungrateful person.

sa: उदपानोदके ग्रामे ब्राह्मणो वृषलीपतिः। उषित्वा द्वादश समाः शूद्रकर्मैव गच्छति॥
en: That Brahmana who, having married a Shudra girl, lives for twelve years continually in a village which has only a well to give water, becomes a Shudra in act.

sa: गायना नर्तकाश्चैव प्लवका वादकास्तथा। कथका योधकाश्चैव राजन् नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: Those Brahmanas who are by profession, vocalists, or dancers or players or instrumental musicians, or reciters of sacred books, or warriors and athletes, should not, O king be invited.

sa: सुनासिकेन कायेन भूत्वा चन्द्रप्रभस्तदा। कृत्वा हयशिरः शुभ्रं वेदानामालयं प्रभुः॥
en: His body, have an excellent nose, became as bright as the Moon. He assumed an equine head of great lustre, that head which was the abode of the Vedas.

sa: यस्तु वक्ता द्वयोरर्थमविरुद्धं प्रभाषते। श्रोतुश्चैवात्मनश्चैव स वक्ता नेतरो नृप॥
en: That speaker, however, who uses words that are, while expressing his own meaning, intelligible to the hearer as well, is a true speaker. No other man deserves the name.

sa: नारायणपरा कीर्तिः श्रीश्च लक्ष्मीश्च देवताः। नारायणपरं सांख्यं योगो नारायणात्मकः॥
en: The presiding gods of Fame, of Beauty, and of Prosperity, have the same Supreme Deity for their soul. Both the Sankhya philosophy and Yoga have Narayana for their soul.

sa: अनुरोधविरोधाभ्यां समः स्यादचलो ध्रुवः। सुकृतं दुष्कृतं चोभे नानुरुध्येत कर्मणा॥
en: By association with Yoga and dissociation from company, he should be perfectly calm, steadily fixed, and uniform. He should not acquire either merit or demerit by means of acts.

sa: नवनीतं यथा दध्मो मलयाच्चन्दनं यथा॥ आरण्यकं च वेदेभ्य ओषधिभ्योऽमृतं यथा। समुद्धृतमिदं ब्रह्मन् कथामृतमिदं तथा॥ तपोनिधे त्वयोक्तं हि नारायणकथाश्रयम्।
en: As butter is raised from curds, sandal-wood from the mountains of Malaya, the Aranyakas from the Vedas, and ambrosia from all the medicinal herbs, similarly, O ocean of austerities, has this discourse that is like ambrosia and that has Narayana for its object, been raised by you, O Brahmana, from various histories and Puranas existing in the world.

sa: उपास्य बहुलास्तस्मिन्नाश्रमे सुमहातपाः। समाः स्वर्गं गतो विप्रः पुत्रेण सहितस्तदा॥
en: Regarding Gautama of austere penances, that Rishi, having worshipped the gods for a long while in that asylum of his, at last went up to heaven with his son.

sa: गृहस्थ एव यजते गृहस्थस्तप्यते तपः। गार्हस्थ्यमस्य धर्मस्य मूलं यत्किचिदेजते॥
en: The householder who lives like a householder, celebrates sacrifices and practise penances. Whatever is done by anybody for acquiring happiness has for its root the domestic mode of life.

sa: आहुः बहुपादानि जङ्गमानि द्वयानि तु। बहुपाट्यो विशिष्टानि द्विपदानि बहून्यपि॥
en: Mobile creatures, whose number is legion, are of two sorts, viz., those that are many legs and those that have two. The latter, however, are superior to the former.

sa: पश्यतामथ यक्षाणां कुण्डधारो महाद्युतिः। निपत्य पतितो भूमौ देवानां भरतर्षभ॥
en: Then, O foremost of Bharata's race, the highly effulgent Kundadhara, bending himself low, laid himself down on the ground before the gods in the presences of all the Yakshas.

sa: गुणा गुणेषु लीयन्ते तदैका प्रकृतिर्भवेत्। क्षेत्रज्ञोऽपि यदा तात तत्क्षेत्रे सम्प्रलीयते॥ तदा क्षरत्वं प्रकृतिर्गच्छते गुणसंश्रिता! निर्गुणत्वं च वैदेह गुणेष्वप्रतिवर्तनात्॥
en: When the principles become merged each into its creator, then the one that remains is Nature. When Soul, too, O son, becomes merged into his own producing cause, then Nature with all the principles in it becomes subject to destruction and attains also to the condition of being without attributes on account of her dissociation from all principles.

sa: एवं स भगवान् व्यासो गुरुर्मम विशाम्पते। कथयामास धर्मज्ञो धर्मराज्ञे द्विजोत्तमः॥ ऋषीणां संनिधौ राजशृण्वतोः कृष्णभीष्मयोः। तस्याप्यकथयत् पूर्वं नारदः सुमहातपाः॥
en: It was even thus, O king, that foremost of twice-born ones, viz., the illustrious Vyasa, my preceptor, well-versed in all duties, described to king Yudhishthira the just this religion of Devotion, in the presence of many Rishis and in the hearing of Krishna and Bhishma. He had got it from the celestial Rishi Narada having penances for wealth.

sa: पुरा शरीरमन्तको भिनत्ति रोगसारथिः। प्रसह्य जीवितक्षये तपो महत् समाचर॥
en: Very soon the Destroyer, having Disease as his charioteer, will with a strong hand, for taking your life, pierce and break your body. Do you, therefore, practise austere penances.

sa: यो ह्यस्माकं गुरुश्रेष्ठः कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः॥ जगौ परमकं जप्यं नारायणमुदीरयन्।
en: He, again, who is our best of preceptors, viz., the Island-born Krishna, devoted to penances, sung, uttering the word Narayana, that great Mantra which is worthy of being silently.

sa: इतरेषु ससंध्येषु संध्यांशेषु ततस्त्रिषु। एकपादेन हीयन्ते सहस्राणि शतानि च॥
en: Regarding the other cycles, the duration of each gradually decreases by a quarter in respect of both the principal period with the minor portion and the conjoining portion itself.

sa: शतयोजनविस्तारे तिर्यगूर्वं च भारत। उदीची दिशमास्थाय रुचिरे संददर्श ह॥
en: Each of them, O Bharata, was a hundred Yojanas in height and of the same breath. Indeed, as Shuka went towards the north, he beheld those two beautiful summits,

sa: उपमन्युरुवाच अपुनर्भवकामानां वैराग्ये वर्ततां च या। प्रकृतीनां लयानां च सा गतिस्त्वं सनातन॥ ज्ञानविज्ञानयुक्तानां निरुपाख्या निरञ्जना। कैवल्या या गतिर्देव परमा सा गतिर्भवान्॥ वेदशास्त्रपुराणोक्ताः पञ्चैता गतयः स्मृताः। त्वत्प्रसादिद्धि लभ्यन्ते न लभ्यन्तेऽन्यथा विभो॥ इति तण्डिस्तपोराशिस्तुष्टावेशानमात्मना। जगौ च परमं ब्रह्म यत् पुरा लोककृज्जगौ॥ एवं स्तुतो महादेवस्तण्डिना ब्रह्मवादिना। उवाच भगवान् देव उमया सहितः प्रभुः॥
en: Upamanyu said You, O Eternal One, are that End of those who seek Liberation from rebirth, who give up all enjoyments, and who desire the annihilation of the elements. You are that high End, O illustrious one, which cannot be described, which is pure, which is the immutable one, and which is theirs who are given to knowledge and science. These are the five Ends described in the Vedas and the scriptures and the Puranas. It is through your favour that persons acquire those ends, or if they fail to attain to them it is through your favour being denied to them. It was thus that Tandi, who was a heap of penances, lauded Ishana. And he sang also that high Brahma which in days of yore was sung by the Creator himself. Thus lauded by that utterer of Brahma, viz., Tandi, Mahadeva, that illustrious an

sa: दृष्टवानस्मि गोविन्द तदस्त्रं रुद्रसंनिधौ। परशुस्तीक्ष्णधारश्च दत्तो रामस्य यः पुरा॥ महादेवेन तुष्टेन क्षत्रियाणां क्षयंकरः। कार्तवीर्यो हतो येन चक्रवर्ती महामृधे॥
en: I saw this weapon, O Govinda, in the hand of Mahadeva. I saw also another weapon, viz., that shar-pedged battle-axe which, was given, formerly unto Rama by Mahadeva for enabling him to root out the Kshatriyas. It was with this weapon that Rama killed in dreadful battle the great Karttaviryya who was the king of the entire world.

sa: पक्वविद्या महाप्राज्ञा जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः। मनसा कर्मणा वाचा नापराध्यन्ति कर्हिचित्॥
en: Of mature knowledge, of great wisdom, with anger under complete control, and with their passions subjugated, they never commit an injury to any one in thought, word, or deed.

sa: तत्र यास्यामि यत्रात्मा शमं मेऽधिगमिष्यति। अक्षयश्चाव्ययश्चैव यत्र स्थास्यामि शाश्वतः॥
en: I shall acquire that situation in which your Soul will have tranquillity, and when I shall be able to live for good without being subject to decrepitude or change.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततोऽगच्छत् स भगवानुत्तरामुत्तरां दिशग्। हिमवन्तं गिरिश्रेष्ठं सिद्धचारणसेवितम्॥
en: Bhishma said The illustrious Ashtavakra started on his journey. He proceeded more and more towards the north and at last reached the Himavat mountains inhabited by Siddhas and Charanas.

sa: पाञ्चरात्रविदो ये तु यथाक्रमपरा नृप। एकान्तभावोपगतास्ते हरि प्रविशन्ति वै॥
en: They who conversant with the Pancharatra Scriptures, who are duly observant of the duties laid down therein, and who are whole-mindedly devoted to Narayana, succeed in entering into Narayana.

sa: क्षीरोदस्य समुद्रस्य मध्ये हाटकसप्रभः। वैजयन्त इति ख्यातः पर्वतप्रवरो नृप॥
en: In the midst of the Ocean of milk, there is a very huge mountain of great effulgence like that of gold, known, O king, by the name of Vaijayanta.

sa: भगवानुवाच अजरचामरश्चैव भव त्वं दुःखवर्जितः। यशस्वी तेजसा युक्तो दिव्यज्ञानसमन्वितः॥
en: The Illustrious God said Be free from every misery and pain and be above decrepitude and death. Be gifted with fame, be endued with great energy, and spiritual knowledge.

sa: गह्वरं प्रतिभात्येतन्मम चिन्तयतोऽनिशम्। नि:संदेहमिदं सर्वं पितामह यथाश्रुति॥ यदैतद् यादृशं चैतद् यथा चैतत् प्रवर्तितम्। निखिलेन महाप्राज्ञ भवानेतद् ब्रवीतु मे॥
en: The subject appears to be inexplicable although I think of it always. O grandfather, O you of great wisdom, you should explain this to me fully, clearly and according to the Shruti. In fact, do you explain to me what it is, what its characteristics are, and the way in which it has come to pass. to me

sa: सर्वे सत्यव्रतपराः सर्वे कामविहारिणः॥ सर्वे वेदव्रतपराः सर्वे चैव बहुश्रुताः।
en: All observed the vow of truth, and all of them sported as they wished. Devoted to the Vedas and Vedic rites, all of them were endued with great learning.

sa: ततस्तुष्टो महादेवः सर्वलोकेश्वरः प्रभुः। एकभक्त इति ज्ञात्वा जिज्ञासां कुरुते तदा॥ शक्ररूपं स कृत्वा तु सर्वैर्देवगणैर्वृतः। सहस्राक्षस्तदा भूत्वा वज्रपाणिर्महायशाः॥
en: After this, the powerful Mahadeva the Lord of all the universe became propitiated with me. Desirous of determining whether I was solely devoted to him only, he appeared before me in the form of Shakra surrounded by all the gods. As the celebrated Shakra, he had a thousand eyes on his body and was armed with the thunderbolt.

sa: ततः सुतं बलेर्जित्वा बाणं बाहुसहस्रिणम्॥ विनाशयिष्यामि ततः सर्वान् सौभनिवासिनः।
en: Defeating next the son of the Danava Vali, viz., Bana, who will be possessed a thousandarms, I shall next destroy all the inhabitants of the Danava city called Saubha.

sa: एतां बुद्ध्वा नरोबुद्ध्या भूतानामागतिं गतिम्। समवेक्ष्य शनैश्चैव लभते शममुत्तमम्॥
en: Man, by understanding with the help of his intelligence, the manner in which creatures come and leave the world, is sure to attain by and by to steadfast peace.

sa: सम्प्राप्तश्च भवानद्य कृतार्थः प्रतियास्यति। विस्रब्यो मां द्विजश्रेष्ठ विषये योक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: When you come here, you are certain to return hence with your object fulfilled. You should, O foremost of twice-born persons, cmploy me to any task with all confidence!

sa: स यथाशास्त्रदृष्टेन मार्गेणेह परिभ्रमन्। वार्षिकांश्चतुरो मासान् पुरा मयि सुखोषितः॥
en: Wandering over the Earth and following path that is pointed out by the scriptures, the learned Panchashika formerly lived happily in my abode for four months during the rains.

sa: महता वातवर्षेण त्रासितास्ते वनौकसः। भयार्ताश्च क्षुधार्ताश्च बभ्रमुः सहिता वने॥
en: All the dwellers of the forest were stricken with fear for that dreadful storm and rain. Terrified and hungry, they roved through the forest in small and large packs.

sa: तथा गोमायुगृध्राभ्यां प्राददत् क्षुद्विनाशनम्॥ वरं पिनाकी भगवान् सर्वभूतहिते रतः।
en: Ever engaged in the behoof of all creatures, the illustrious holder of Pinaka granted a boon to both the jackal and the vulture for which their hunger was appeased.

sa: महाजना छुपावृत्ता राजधर्म समाश्रिताः। न हि सर्वहितः कश्चिदाचारः सम्प्रवर्तते॥
en: Many great men, again, neglecting the duties of their own order, follow those of the Kshatriyas. No such conduct, therefore, is to be seen, which is for universal benevolence.

sa: तस्य स्म शतमाचार्या वसन्ति सततं गृहे। दर्शयन्तः पृथग्धर्मान् नानाश्रमनिवासिनः॥
en: One hundred preceptors always used to live in his palace, describing to him the various courses of duty followed by people who had adopted the various modes of life.

sa: ये सर्वभावानुगताः प्रपद्यन्ते महेश्वरम्। प्रपन्नवत्सलो देवः संसारात् तान् समुद्धरेत्॥
en: The illustrious Deity, who is always bent upon showing favour to them who seek him with humility rescues them from the world who throw themselves whole mindedly upon him.

sa: राजर्षिरधृतिः स्वर्गात् पतितो हि महाभिषः। ययातिः क्षीणपुण्योऽपि धृत्या लोकानवाप्तवान्।॥
en: The royal sage Mahabhisha, for want of this firinness, fell from heaven. Yayati, also, though his merits had become exhausted succeeded in regaining regions of happiness through his firmness.

sa: नारद उवाच तत्त्वं जिज्ञासतां पूर्वमृषीणां भावितात्मनाम्। सनत्कुमारो भगवानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Narada said In days of yore the illustrious Sanatkumara had said these words to certain Rishis of purified souls who had gone to him for enquiring after the truth.

sa: नारसिंहं वपुः कृत्वा हिरण्यकशिपुं पुनः॥ सुरकार्ये हनिष्यामि यज्ञघ्नं दितिनन्दनम्।
en: Assuming the form then of a Manlion, I shall, for doing good to the gods, kill Hiranyakasipu, the son of Diti, who will be a great destroyer of sacrifices.

sa: बृस्यस्तेषां तु संन्यस्ता राक्षसेन्द्रस्य शासनात्। भूमौ वरकुशा: स्तीर्णाः प्रेष्यैर्भरतसत्तम्॥
en: By the order of the king, skins were spread out of them. The royal servants then, O best of the Bharatas, spread mats of Kusha grass on the ground.

sa: सा सलज्जा विहस्याह पुत्रं देहि सुरोत्तम। बलवन्तं महाकायं सर्वदर्पप्रभञ्जनम्॥
en: Smiling in bashfulness, she said, "O best of celestials, give me a son, who is strong, who is huge and how is capable of humbling the pride of everybody."

sa: तेषु जातेषु वृद्धेषु गतेषु परमां गतिम्॥ अब्रवीद्धारतं लोके मानुषेऽस्मिन्महानृषिः।
en: The great Rishi Vyasa did not publish this Bharata to the world of mankind until these his sons were born, grown up and (died) (went on the supreme journey).

sa: शक्र उवाच वाक्येनानेन तुष्टोऽहं यत्त्वयोक्तमिहाण्डजा यमिच्छसि वरं मत्तस्तं गृहाण
en: Indra said: O oviparous One, I am highly pleased with what you have just now said. O best of birds, accept from me any boon you like to have.

sa: तदिदं ब्राह्मणस्यास्य दुःखमापतितं ध्रुवम्। तत्रास्य यदि साहाय्यं कुर्यामुपकृतं भवेत्॥
en: This Brahmana has certainly fallen into a great distress. If we can be of any help to him (in his present distress), we should by (somewhat) repay his services.

sa: द्वितीयं तु सभापर्व बहुवृत्तान्तमुच्यते। सभाक्रिया पाण्डवानां किंकराणां च दर्शनम्॥
en: The second is Sabha Parva which is very extensive and full of matter. It describes the building of the assembly-hall by the Pandavas and the review of their servants;

sa: गाण्डीवधन्वा समरे सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य यत्र पार्थो महाधनुः॥
en: The bearer of the Gandiva and the greatest warrior in battle among all wielders of weapons. In it also is narrated how the bowman Arjuna, placing Shikhandi before him.

sa: स दृष्ट्वा सूर्यसंकाशं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा। उपविष्टं वसिष्ठस्य सव्यपार्श्वे महामुनिम्॥
en: He saw the great ascetic Durbásā, burning like the sun in his effulgence, seated on the right hand side of Vasiștha. Thereupon he humbly saluted those two leading ascetics.

sa: पाञ्चालनगरे चापि लक्ष्यं भित्त्वा धनंजयः। द्रौपदी लब्धवानत्र मध्ये सर्वमहीक्षिताम्॥
en: The hitting of the mark at the city of Panchala by Arjuna and the acquisition of Draupadi by him in the midst of all the kings of the world.

sa: त्रैलोक्यविजयार्थाय भवद्भ्यामास्थितं तपः। हेतुनानेन दैत्येन्द्रौ न वा कामं करोम्यहम्॥
en: You have undergone your ascetic penances for the subjugation of the three worlds; O chiefs of the Danavas, it is for this I cannot grant you what you desire.

sa: न खल्वद्यैव सौमित्रे जीवितं जाह्नवीजले। त्यजेयं राजवंशस्तु भर्तुर्मे परिहास्यते॥
en: O Saumitri, I shall just renounce my life in the waters of Jāhnavi? But I desist from this for it shall bring about the termination O my husband's race.

sa: तस्या वायुर्नदीतीरे वसनं व्यहरत् तदा। अपकृष्टाम्बरां दृष्ट्वा तामृषिश्चकमे तदा॥
en: A wind rose on the banks of the river and made the cloth of the Apsara) fall from her body. Seeing her nude, the Rishi was filled with desire.

sa: ततो देवानुपागम्य प्रोचुरेवं महर्षयः। अद्यार्धरात्रसमये सर्वलोकभयावहः॥ उत्पत्स्यते महान्दाहस्त्रैलोक्यस्य विनाशनः।
en: Thereupon the great Rishis, came to the celestials and said; “Today in the middle of the night, a fire, fearful to all creatures, will rise to destroy the universe."

sa: सौतिरुवाच इत्युक्त्वा धृतराष्ट्रोऽथ विलप्य बहुदुःखितः। मूर्च्छितः पुनराश्वस्त: संजयं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sauti said: Bewailing his fate thus, Dhritarashtra was overcome with the greatest sorrow and lost his senses for a time. But being revived, he addressed Sanjaya in these words.

sa: युधिष्ठिरं पूजयित्वा भीमसेनं यमौ तथा। परिष्वक्तो भृशं तैस्तु यमाभ्यामभिवादितः॥
en: He then worshipped Yudhishthira and also Bhimasena and he embraced the twins. Being embraced in return (by the sons of Pritha) and worshipped by the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva).

sa: शास्त्रतः पूजितश्चैव सम्यक् तेन महात्मना। स भीष्मेण महाभागस्तुष्टोऽस्त्रविदुषां वरः॥
en: That foremost of all men skilled in arms, that illustrious man (Drona) was pleased with the reception given to him by great Bhishma and accepted them as his pupils.

sa: शकुन्तलोवाच गत: पिता मे भगवान् फलान्याहर्तुमाश्रमात्। मुहूर्तं सम्प्रतीक्षस्व द्रष्टास्येनमुपागतम्॥
en: Shakuntala said : My noble father has gone away from the hermitage to collect fruits. Kindly wait for a moment and you will see him when he will come.

sa: सौतिरुवाच ततः कामगम: पक्षी महावीर्यो महाबलः। मातुरन्तिकमागच्छत्परं पारं महोदधेः॥
en: Sauti said: Then the bird, of great strength and energy, capable of going every where at will, went to his mother on the other side of the great ocean.

sa: अयं काल इति ज्ञात्वा कुन्ती समुपसृत्य तान्। गतासूनमृतेनेव जीवयन्तीदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thinking that to be the (proper) time (to appear before them), Kunti came to them and reviving them as nectar revives a dead man, she thus spoke (to them).

sa: ताभिः सार्धं प्रयातास्मि लोकपालनिवेशनम्। ततः पश्यामहे सर्वा ब्राह्मणं संशितव्रतम्॥
en: One day accompanied by them, I was going to the abode of the protector of the world; when we were all going, we saw a Brahmana of rigid vows.

sa: त्वमग्निहव्यवाहस्त्वं त्वमेव परमं हविः। मनीषिणस्त्वां जानन्ति बहुधा चैकधापि च॥
en: O Agni, you are the career of (sacrificial) ghee, you are the great (sacrificial) ghee itself. The wise know you to be one and (at the same time) Many.

sa: चक्रे च वेश्मनस्तस्य मध्येनातिमहद् बिलम्। कपाटयुक्तमज्ञातं समं भूम्याश्च भारत॥
en: He made that subterranean passage in the centre of the house. O descendant of Bharata, it was in a level with the floor and closed up by doors (planks).

sa: स्नाताः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे हृष्टपुष्टाश्च वानराः। दृढं किलकिलाशब्दैः सर्वं राममनुव्रतम्॥
en: All the females and males, with their beasts, birds and friends, delightedly followed Raghava. Bathed and delighted all the monkeys, healthy and joyous following Rāma, created a continued tumult.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अर्जुनेनैवमुक्तस्तु भीमो रोषाज्ज्वलन्निव। बलमाहारयामास यद् वायोर्जगतः क्षये॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by Arjuna, Bhima blazed up in anger. He summoned the strength that Bahu puts forth at the time of the universal dissolution.

sa: तपोधनैश्च ये क्रुद्धैः शापा उक्ता महात्मभिः। नाक्रामन्त तयोस्तेऽपि वरदाननिराकृताः॥
en: The curses uttered by the high-souled ascetics in anger became futile on account of the boons granted to them (by Brahma); but they did not any way affect them.

sa: कच्चित् तातापविलं ते कच्चिन्नन्दसि पुत्रक। अजानतामदोषाणां सर्वेषां रक्षसां वधात्॥
en: “O child, I hope there is no obstruction to your this sacrifice. Do you take, Pleasure, O child, in destroying the Rakshasas who know nothing of your father's death.

sa: श्रुत्वा चैनं नरश्रेष्ठ पार्थिवस्य पराभवम्। अस्य चर्षेरुत्तङ्कस्य विधत्स्व यदनन्तरम्॥
en: O best of kings, you have now heard how (your father) the great king of the world was killed and how Rishi Uttanka was insulted, do what is proper.

sa: अतीवरूपसंपन्नां सिद्धानामपि काक्षिताम्। दृष्ट्वैव स च तां धीमांश्चकमे चारुहासिनीम्॥
en: She was exceedingly beautiful, an object of desire with even a Siddha. As soon as the wise Rishi saw the girl of sweet smiles, he desired to have her.

sa: ते प्रातिष्ठन्त सहिता नगरान्नागसाह्वयात्। प्रस्थाने चाभवन्मन्त्री क्षत्ता तेषां महात्मनाम्॥
en: They (the Pandavas) went away with their mother from Hastinapur and when they went away, the son of the Vaisya woman (Vidura) became the adviser of those illustrious men.

sa: अयुध्यमानं सचिवं वव्रे कृष्णं धनंजयः। मद्रराजं च राजानमायान्तं पाण्डवान्प्रति॥
en: Arjuna chose to possess Krishna as a counsellor, although he will not fight. Then is related the coming of the king of Madra for the assistance of the Pandavas.

sa: नदीं चाश्रमसंश्लिष्टां पुण्यतोयां ददर्श सः। सर्वप्राणभृतां तत्र जननीमिव धिष्ठिताम्॥
en: He saw that the hermitage was situated on the banks of the river, a most sacred one and she flowed as the mother of all the creatures living there.

sa: पूर्वमागस्कृतो गत्वा दशार्णाः समरे जिताः। पाण्डुना नरसिंहेन कौरवाणां यशोभृता।२५॥
en: Pandu marched against the enemies with such strong forces (as narrated above). Going to the east, that best of men, that spreader of Kuru fame, Pandu, defeated the Dasharnas.

sa: स चिन्तयन्नभ्यगच्छत् सुबहुप्रसवान् खगान्। शाह्निकां शाट्टिको भूत्वा जरितां समुपेयिवान्॥
en: After reflection, he came to the conclusion that the birds alone have the greatest power of fecundity. Becoming a Sharanagaka, he had connection, with a female Sharangaka, named Jarita.

sa: आदित्यैर्हि तदा दैत्या बहुशो निर्जिता युधि। ऐश्वर्याभ्रंशिताः स्वर्गात्संबभूवुः क्षिताविह॥
en: The sons of Diti, (the Asuras), having been continually defeated by the sons of Aditi, (the celestials) and deprived of sovereignty and heaven, began to take birth on earth.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच तपोविशिष्टादपि वै विशिष्टान्मुनिसंचयात्। मन्ये श्रेष्ठतरं त्वां वै रहस्यज्ञानवेदनात्॥
en: Brahma said : For your knowledge of the Divine Mystery, I have the highest regard for you amongst all the celebrated Rishis who are famous for their holy lives.

sa: उत्थापयिष्ये यद्येनं ध्रुवं कोपं करिष्यति। धर्मलोपो भवेदस्य संध्यातिक्रमणे ध्रुवम्॥
en: But if I wake him, he will surely be angry. If the time for prayer passes away (without his doing it,) he will certainly sustain the loss of virtue.

sa: यस्मिञ्जाते महातेजाः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। अयुतं गा द्विजातिभ्यः प्रादान्निष्कांश्च भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata on the birth of this child the powerful son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, gave away to the Brahmanas ten thousand kine and many thousand gold coins.

sa: स्वकर्मनिरता विप्रा नानृतं तेषु विद्यते। स चाद्भुतमहावीर्यो वज्रसंहननो युवा॥
en: The Brahmanas were always engaged in their duties and they were very truthful. He (Dushyanta) was a young prince of wonderful prowess and of a body like the thunder-bolt.

sa: श्वेतकेतुरुवाच व्युच्चरन्त्याः पतिं नार्या अद्यप्रभृति पातकम्॥ भ्रूणहत्यासमं घोरं भविष्यत्यसुखावहम्।
en: Svetaketu said: The wife, not adhering to her husband, will be sinful from this date; she will commit as great and painful sin as the killing of an embryo.

sa: सुविभक्तानवद्याङ्गी स्वसितायतलोचना। स्वाचारा चैव साध्वी च सुवेषा चैव भामिनी॥
en: She was perfectly semetrical in body and faultless in features; she had black and large eyes; she was attired in beautiful robes; she was chaste and exceedingly well conducted.

sa: उत्सङ्गेऽस्याः शिरः कृत्वा सुष्वाप परिखिन्नवत्। तस्मिंश्च सुप्ते विप्रेन्द्रे सविताऽस्तमियागिरिम्॥
en: Placing his head on the lap of his wife, slept, looking like one fatigued. When the Brahmana was thus sleeping, the sun entered the summit of the western mountain.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्य कर्णस्य व्रीडावनतमाननम्। बभौ वर्षाम्बुविक्लिन्नं पद्ममागलितं यथा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus addressed, Karna's face was flushed! with the blushes of shame and it looked like the pale lotus torn and disfigured by the showers of rains.

sa: स लोकानफलान् दृष्ट्वा तपसा निर्जितानपि। पप्रच्छ धर्मराजस्य समीपस्थान् दिवौकसः॥
en: He asked the dwellers of heaven (celestial) sitting round Dharmaraja (the king of the dead) what was the cause of his not getting the fruits of his severe asceticism.

sa: तं समुत्थापयामास नृपतिं काममोहितम्। भूतलाद् भूमिपालेशं पितेव पतितं सुतम्॥
en: As a father rises up the son fallen (on the ground) he raised up the king, lying senseless on the ground having been deprived of his senses by desire.

sa: ततः पुण्ये शिवे देशे शान्तिं कृत्वा महारथाः। नगरं मापयामासुद्वैपायनपुरोगमाः॥
en: Those great car-warriors, selecting with the assistance of Dvaipayana a sacred and auspicious place, performed the propitiatory ceremonies and measured out a piece of land to found a city.

sa: आशीविषैः कृष्णसपैं: सुप्तं चैनमदंशयत्। सर्वेष्वेवाङ्गदेशेषु न ममार च शत्रुहा॥
en: While asleep, he was caused to be bitten in every part of his body by black snakes of virulent poisons, but that chastiser of foes did not still perish.

sa: काले वर्षति पर्जन्यः सुभिक्षं विमला दिशः। हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णं पुरं जनपदास्तथा॥
en: On account of showers in proper time there was enough of food in his kingdom. The quarters were pure and delightful. The citizens and villagers were happy and healthy.

sa: ततो राजानमामन्त्र्य निर्गतो विदुरो बहिः। भारद्वाजो महाप्राज्ञो मापयामास मेदिनीम्॥
en: Thereupon Vidura, giving the necessary assurance to the king, went out to do what he was bidden. The greatly learned son of Bharadvaja (Drona) measured a piece of (ground).

sa: रुरुरुवाच आयुषोऽर्धं प्रयच्छामि कन्यायै खेचरोत्तम। श्रृंगाररूपाभरणा समुत्तिष्ठतु मे प्रिया॥
en: Ruru said: O best of heaven's messengers, 1 give up half of my life to my bride. Let my beloved one rise in the beautiful form decked with ornaments.

sa: पाञ्चालीं प्राहुरक्लिष्टां वासुदेवस्य शृण्वतः। दुर्योधनस्तव क्रोधाद् देवि त्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्॥
en: They, (the courtiers) in the hearing of Vasudeva, said to the daughter of Panchala (Draupadi), “O lady, Duryodhana shall certainly give up his life on account of your wrath.

sa: नष्टा वसुमती कृत्स्ना पाताले चैव मज्जिता। पुनरुद्धरिता तेन वाराहेणैकङ्गिणा॥
en: Once the whole earth was lost, it sunk into the nether regions. But she was again lifted up by him (Vishnu) who had assumed the form of a boar.

sa: नन्वहं कृष्ण भीष्मस्यधृतराष्ट्रस्य चोभयोः। स्नुषा भवामिधर्मेण साहं दासीकृता बलात्॥
en: O Krishna, I am the daughter-in-law of both Bhishma and Dhritarashtra according to the ordinance, yet, О slayer of Madhu, they wished to make me their slave by force.

sa: दासीभावेन मां भोक्तुमीषुस्ते मधुसूदन। जीवत्सु पाण्डुपुत्रेषु पञ्चालेषु च वृष्णिषु॥
en: O slayer of Madhu, though the Pandavas, the Panchalas and the Vrishnis were present, yet they (the sons of Dhritarashtra) dared express their desire of making me their slave.

sa: तद बभौ रौद्रबीभत्सं बीभत्सोर्यानमाहवे। आक्रीडमिव रुद्रस्य घनतः कालात्यय पशून्॥
en: Then the chariot of Vibhastsu shone fierce and dreadful in that battle, like the chariot of Rudra himself when at the end of a Yuga he slays all creatures.

sa: वारुणेन ततः कर्णः शमयामास पावकम्। जीमूतैश्च दिशः सर्वाश्चके तिमिरदुर्दिनाः॥
en: Karna, however, put out that fire with Varuna (watery) weapon. Suta's son covered all the directions with clouds created by his arrows and it appeared like a rainy day.

sa: त्वं च सूतकुले जातो विनीतः सूतकर्मणि। धर्मज्ञश्चासि वृष्णीनामाहवेष्वपि दारुके॥
en: You are born in the race of Sutas (charioteers) and you are well-skilled in your profession. O son of Daruka, you know the usage of the Vrishnis in battle.

sa: स भवान् देववत् प्राज्ञो ज्ञात्वा भवमयं जगत्। अवाकर्षस्त्वमात्मानं नियमैस्तत्प्रियेप्सया॥
en: Being embodied, your intelligent self considered the world to be pervaded by Mahadeva; and then for propitiating that god you emaciated your body by the observance of hard vows.

sa: कर्ण शोभिष्यसे नूनं पञ्चभिर्धातृभिर्वृतः। देवैः परिवृतो ब्रह्मा वेद्यामिव महाध्वरे॥
en: O Karna, you will surely shine surrounded by your five brothers like Brahma surrounded by the gods seated on the dais on the occasion of a great sacrificial ceremony.

sa: ऋत्विज ऊचुः अस्ति राजन्महत्सत्रं त्वदर्थं देवनिर्मितम्। सर्पसत्रमितिख्यातं पुराणे परिपठ्यते॥
en: The Ritwijas said : O king, there is a sacrifice advised by the celestials for you. It is known as the Snakesacrifice and is spoken of in the Puranas.

sa: व्यपेतहृदयत्रासा आवद्रूस्तं महारथाः। आर्छत् पार्थो गुरुं भारं सर्वभारसहो युधि॥
en: With their hearts shorn of fear, those mighty warriors completely encompassed him. Thereat Partha capable of bearing all burdens how heavy sover, took up that burden in that battle.

sa: निकेतः श्रूयते पुण्ये यत्र वश्रवसो मुनेः। जज्ञेधनपतिर्यत्र कुबेरो नरवाहनः॥
en: It has been heard by us that the sacred hermitage of Rishi Vishvasrava stood there and there the lord of wealth, Kubera, having man as his vehicle, was born.

sa: तस्माद् यो रक्षति नृपः स धर्मेणेति पूज्यते। अधीते चापि यो विप्रो वैश्यो यश्चार्जने रतः॥ यश्च शुश्रूषते शूद्रः सततं नियतेन्द्रियः। अतोऽन्यथा मनुष्येन्द्र स्वधर्मात् परिहीयते॥
en: Hence, that king, who, according to the duties laid down for his order, protects the other classes, becomes worthy of respect. similarly, the Brahmana who is employed in studying the scriptures, the Vaishya who is engaged in acquiring riches, and the Shudra who is always engaged in serving the three other classes with rapt attention, become objects of reverence. By acting in other ways, O king, each order is said to deviate from virtue.

sa: अश्वानां काक्षितार्थानां षडिमानि शतानि वै। शतद्वयेन कन्येय भवता प्रतिगृह्यताम्॥
en: "Of the horses asked for by you there are six hundred here and this damsel is a substitute for the other two hundred. Let these be accepted by you.

sa: विमानितो हतः क्रुश्स्त्रातारं चेन विन्दति। अमानुषकृतस्तत्र दण्डो हन्ति नराधिपम्॥
en: If a person, who has been humiliated or struck, fails, while crying for help, to get a protector, divine punishment over takes the king and brings about his fall.

sa: एभिः कालात्मकैर्भावैर्यः सर्वैः सर्वमन्वितम्। पश्यत्यकलुषं कर्म स मोहं नानुवर्तते॥
en: That man who regards all living creatures as unsullied though endued with all these entities having time for their essence, has never to perform acts moved on by error.

sa: दश विद्याद् धमन्योऽत्र पञ्चेन्द्रियगुणावहाः। याभिः सूक्ष्माः प्रतायन्ते धमन्योऽन्याः सहस्रशः॥
en: Know that there are ten principle canals. These help the functions of the five senses. From those ten issue out thousands of other passages that are minuter in form.

sa: केशलोमनखान् वाप्य वानप्रस्थो मुनिस्ततः। आश्रमादाश्रमं पुण्यं पूतो गच्छति कर्मभिः॥
en: Practising austerities while living like a forest recluse, one should shave off and having purified himself by acts, pass into the fourth and the last holy mode of life.

sa: कथं द्रक्ष्यामि वः सर्वान् स्वयमाहृतभोजनान्। मद्भक्त्या क्लिश्यतोऽनर्हान् धिक् पापान्धृतराष्ट्रजान्।
en: How shall I see you all, my well-wishers, who do not deserve to suffer any trouble, subsist on food procured by yourselves? O fie on the sons of Dhritarashtra!

sa: तस्मात् सोमोऽप्यविक्रेयः पुरुषेण विपश्चिता। विक्रयं त्विह सोमस्य गर्हयन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: It is for this reason that Soma plants should never be destroyed by wise men. They who sell the Soma plant are held in low esteem by the wise.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा जरासंधः सहदेवाभिषेचनम्। आज्ञापयत् तदा राजा युयुत्सुर्भीमकर्मभिः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this, and being willing to fight with those heroes of fearful deeds (Krishna etc.), Jarasandha ordered his son Sahadeva to be installed on the throne.

sa: एतस्याः सलिलं मूर्ध्नि वृषाङ्कः पर्यधारयत्। गङ्गाद्वारे महाभाग येन लोकस्थितिर्भवेत्॥
en: O greatly blessed one, that protector of the world, Vrishanka (Shiva) received on his head the all of the waters of this river at the source of the Ganges.

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वार्जुनः कृष्णं शिष्टान् संशप्तकांस्तदा। आक्षिप्य शस्त्रेण बलाद् दैत्यानिन्द्र इवावधीत्॥
en: Having uttered-so be it, to Krishna, Arjuna then forcibly struck down the rest of the army of the Samsaptakas; and slaughtered them, even as Indra had slaughtered the Daityas.

sa: ते विबाहुशिरस्त्राणाः प्रहताः कर्णसायकैः। पेतुः पृथिव्यां युगपच्छिन्नं शालवनं यथा॥
en: Shorn of their arms and head-dresses and killed by Karna with his arrows they fell down all at once on earth like a forest of Sala trees cut down.

sa: असारश्चापि दुर्मेधाः केवलं बहु भाषसे। क्रोधादिभिरवच्छन्नो मिथ्या वदसि शाल्मले॥
en: You are worthless and of a wicked understanding, you are but making an idleboast. Your intelligence being confounded by anger and other passions, you indulge in untruths, O Shalmali.

sa: तैः शरैर्दोणपुत्रस्य वज्रवेगैः समाहताः। प्रदग्धा रिपव: पेतुरग्निदग्धा इव द्रुमाः॥
en: Wounded with those arrows of Drona's son, arrows endued with the energy of the thunder, his foes, scorched and consumed began to fall down like trees consumed by fire.

sa: ततोऽन्तरिक्षे निनदो महानभूद् दिवौकसामप्सरसां च नेदुषाम्। पपात चौचैरमरप्रवेरितं विचित्रपुष्पोत्करवर्षमुत्तमम्॥
en: A loud uproar was then heard in they sky made by the celestials and the Apsaras. A shower of flowers of sweet fragrance, rained by the celestials, poured in.

sa: एवं बहुविधैर्दुःखैः पीड्यमानामनाथवत्। शोकसागरमध्यस्थां किं मां भीम न पश्यसि॥
en: O Bhima, why do you not look at me who am stationed in the midst of the sea of sorrow and afflicted like a helpless one, with various woes.

sa: तेषां चापभुजोत्सृष्टा शरवृष्टिविशाम्पते। आच्छादयद् दिशः सर्वा धारा इव पयोमुचः॥
en: Those showers of arrows discharged from their bows and arms, O monarch, covered all the points of the horizon like a thick downpour of rain poured from the clouds.

sa: अहन्यहनि तद्भावमुपेन्द्रं योऽधिगच्छति। समाप्ते भोजयेद् विप्रानथवा दापयेद् घृतम्॥ अतः परं नोपवासो भवतीति विनिश्चयः। उवाच भगवान् विष्णुः स्वयमेव पुरातनम्॥
en: Likewise he who adores Krishna every day as Upendra, acquires oneness with him. After Krishna has been adored thus, one should, at the conclusion of his vow, feed a number of Brahmanas or make gifts of clarified butter to them. The illustrious Vishnu, that ancient Being, has himself said that there is no fast which possesses superior merits.

sa: कर्णोऽप्याविष्टचित्तात्मा नरकस्यान्तरात्मना॥ अर्जुनस्य वधे क्रूरां करोति स्म तदा मतिम्।
en: O foremost of Bharatas, Karna also, his soul and mind possessed by Naraka and influenced by the qualities of emotion and darkness, became cagerly desirous of killing Falguni (Arjuna).

sa: अस्माभिस्तु गतं सार्धं विनीतवदुपस्थितम्। आनुपूर्व्यात्तु सुग्रीवो राज्ये त्वां स्थापयिष्यति॥
en: On the contrary, if you in humble guise present yourself (before him) along with us, he shall-establish you in the kingdom, in consideration of your being the next heir.

sa: पुरैकेन हि भीष्मेण विजिताः सर्वपार्थिवाः। मृते पितर्यतिक्रुद्धो रथेनैकेन भारत॥
en: In days of old, all the rulers of the earth were conquered by the single Bhima seated on the single car, extremely wrathful on the death of his father.

sa: गच्छत्यस्तं दिनकरे दीप्यमाना इवांशवः। स निर्भिन्नो रणे भीमो नाराचैर्मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: Like the burning rays of the sun while it towards the Western mountains. Pierced in both the arms with those Narachas capable of cutting to the very quick, Bhima.

sa: अगस्त्यं कौशिकं चैव तावुभौ ब्राह्मणोत्तमौ। अर्चयाहूय सौमित्रे रत्नैः सस्यमिवाम्बुभिः॥
en: O son of Sumiträ, do you invite the excellent Brāhmaṇas, Agastya and Viśvāmitra, and adore them, O Raghava, by conferring upon them gems, as people cherish corn with water.

sa: एक एवैष भगवान् विज्ञेयः प्रथमोऽङ्गिराः॥ बहुधा निःसृतः कायाज्ज्योतिष्टोमः क्रतुर्यथा।
en: This adorable and exalted being, the firstborn fire, must be considered as all the fires, for like the Jyotishtoma sacrifice, he came out of Angira's body in various forms.

sa: नक्षत्रेण च सौम्येन पुरस्कृत्याङ्गिरःसुतम्। भरतः सह सैन्येन कुमाराभ्यां विनिर्ययौ॥
en: There upon under the auspices of favourable stars, having placed Gargya, son of Aigiras before them, Bharata with the princes and army issued out of the city of Ayodhyā.

sa: हर्यश्वस्य च दायादः काशिराजोऽभ्यषिच्यता सुदेवो देवसंकाशः साक्षाद् धर्म इवापरः॥
en: Meanwhile Haryashva's son Sudeva who looked like a celestial in splendour and who was a second god of virtue, was installed on the throne of Kashi as its king.

sa: यद्यस्य धनुषो रामः कुर्यादारोपणं मुने। सुतामयोनिजां सीतां दद्यां दाशरथेरहम्॥
en: O you of excellent vows. And, if, Ascetic, Rāma succeeds in fixing string to it, I will confer upon Daſaratha's son my daughter unsprung from the usual source. Sītā,

sa: ते राज्ञो धृतराष्ट्रस्य सामात्यस्य महारथाः। वैरं प्रतिकरिष्यन्ति कुलोच्छेदन पाण्डवाः॥
en: The sons of Pandu, these mighty carwarriors, will have their revenge for their wrongs by the extinction of the race of the king Dhritarashtra with that of his ministers.

sa: अपापां यदुपैक्षस्त्वं कृष्णामेतां सभागताम्। तद् दुःखमतितिक्षाम मा वधीष्म कुरूनिति॥
en: "The insults you have offered to the blameless Krishna who had been brought to this council hall, we will quietly endure so that the Kurus may not be slaughtered.

sa: ये योनिशुद्धाः सततं तपस्यभिरता भृशम्। दानाध्ययनसम्पन्नास्ते वै पूज्यतमाः सदा॥
en: Those men who are of pure birth, who are devoted to penances and who make gifts and study the Vedas, are considered as worthy of the most respectful adoration

sa: भिन्नमन्त्रोऽपराद्धश्च भिन्नशक्तिः कथं ह्यहम्। किष्किन्धां प्राप्य जीवेयमनाथ इव दुर्बलः॥
en: How can I, whose counsels have been revealed, who have transgressed, and who have been deprived of my power, repairing to Kiş kindhā like one forlorn and feeble, live?

sa: ध्रुवमेषु निमित्तेषु भूमिमाश्रित्य पार्थिवाः॥ स्वप्स्यन्ति निहताः कर्ण शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: It is evident from these evil omens O Karna, that hundreds and thousands of kings, deprived of their lives, will sleep the eternal sleep in the field of battles.

sa: मित्रबुद्ध्या च गोमायुं सान्त्वयित्वा प्रसाद्य च। दोषैस्तु समतां नेतुमैच्छन्नशुभबुद्धयः॥
en: Those wicked persons at first tried to please and win him over with friendly conduct and make him put up with the various abuses which existed in the state.

sa: न संतापं महाबाहो मदर्थं कर्तुमर्हसि। पूर्णनिर्माणबद्धा हि कालस्य गतिरीदृशी॥
en: Be not aggrieved for me, O you having mighty' arms. Such is the course of time; the movements of creatures are destined by their pristine actions, good or bad.

sa: ततः शशाप तान् क्रोधात् ते शप्ताश्चेतना जहुः। मृगपक्षिसधर्माणः क्षिप्रमासञ्जडोपमाः॥
en: Then he cursed them in great anger; and having been thus cursed they lost their sense and became like inanimate objects. They became in conduct like beasts and birds.

sa: यस्य शूरा महेष्वासाः प्रत्यनीकगता रणे। प्रभग्ना विनिवर्तन्ते कृतास्त्रा युद्धदुर्मदाः॥
en: Meeting with him in battle, fierce bowmen, endowed with heroism, accomplished in the use of weapons and incapable of being easily defeated in battle, were compelled to turn back.

sa: हयौधान् निहतान् दृष्ट्वा द्रवमाणांस्ततस्ततः। रणे माधवपार्थाभ्यां मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Mescems my sons are lamenting seeing large bodies of steeds slain and routed in all directions in battle, by the son of Pritha and the descendant of Madhu's race.

sa: एवं संजल्पतां तेषां तावकानां महारथः। आयाज्जवेन कौन्तेयो रथघोषेण नादयन्॥
en: When your soldiers had been thus conversing, the mighty car-warrior, the son of Kunti (Arjuna) rushed there with impetuosity, resounding the welkin with the rattle of his car and

sa: ततस्तु वायोर्वचनं निशम्य सौमित्रिरिन्द्रप्रतिमानवीर्यः। समादधे बाणमथोग्रवेगं तद्ब्राह्ममस्त्रं सहसा नियुज्य।१८॥
en: Hearing the words of the wind-god, Sumitrā's son like to Indra in prowess took an arrow endowed with fierce impetuosity, and at once set it on a Brahma weapon.

sa: ब्राह्मणस्त्रिषु कालेषु शस्त्रं गृह्णन्न दुष्यति। आत्मत्राणे वर्णदोषे दुर्दम्यनियमेषु च॥
en: The Brahmana, by fighting on these three occasions, does not commit sin, viz., for protecting himself, for compelling the other castes to follow their duties, and for punishing robbers,

sa: सत्त्वेषु लिङ्गमावेश्य निर्लिङ्गमपि तत् स्वयम्। मन्यन्ते ध्रुवमेवैनं ये जनास्तत्त्वदर्शिनः॥
en: Though it is by nature without attributes yet it enters all existent objects and as such is clothed with attributes. Those persons who know truth consider Brahma as eternal.

sa: दूषितं परदोषैर्हि गृहीते योऽन्यथा शुचिम्। स्वयं संदूषितामात्यः क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति॥
en: That king, who considers a really innocent person falsely accused by his enemies to be guilty, is soon ruined by the wicked ministers who create that conviction in him!

sa: नूनं पार्थार्थमेवास्मान् मोहयन्ति दिवौकसः। यत् कर्णभीमप्रभवैर्वध्यते नो बलं शरैः॥
en: 'Indeed for the sake of the Parthas even the gods are robbing us of our senses, inasmuch as those arrows shot both by Bhima and Karna and slaying us.'

sa: वीतहव्यो महाराज ब्रह्मवादित्वमेव च। तस्य गृत्समदः पुत्रो रूपेणेन्द्र इवापरः॥
en: And he acquired also a complete mastery of all the Vedas through the same Vitahavya had a son named Gritsamada who in beauty of person was a second Indra.

sa: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः। सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान् प्राप्नुयात् पुण्यकर्मणाम्।।
en: Even he, who with faith and without evil, will hear it, being freed from (the bond of births), will obtain the blessed seat of those that perform pious acts.

sa: अदृश्यत ततः साक्षाद् भगवान् गोवृषध्वजः। उमासहायो व्यालधृग् बहुरूपः पिनाकधूक्॥
en: (Then) that very divine being, the wielder of the Pinaka, capable of assuming many shapes, having the bull for his emblem and bearing serpents, appeared before me with Uma.

sa: आप्लुतश्च ततो यानं चित्रसेनस्य धन्विनः। हाहाभूतं जगश्चासीद् दृष्ट्वा राजानमाहवे॥
en: He then ascended the car of Chitrasena that great bowman. Then cries of Alas and Oh were uttered by your troops as they beheld the king in that battle.

sa: उक्तमेतत् पुरा राजन् मया गुणवतस्तव। दुर्योधनापराधेन प्रजेयं वै विनक्ष्यति॥
en: O king, endued with all accomplishments as you are, I have told you long ago that for the fault of Duryodhana, the subjects of this kingdom will be annihilated.

sa: सुदु:खं पुरुषज्ञानं चित्तं ह्येषां चलाचलम्। समर्थो वाप्यशङ्को वा शतेष्वेकोऽधिगम्यते॥
en: Those kings, whose hearts are restless and unquiet; cannot gain a true knowledge of men. Only one in a hundred can be found who is either capable or undaunted.

sa: ततः कर्णमुखान् दृष्ट्वा क्षत्रियान् युद्धदुर्मदान्। सम्पेततुरभीतौ तौ गजौ प्रतिगजानिव॥
en: Seeing the Kshatriyas, ever furious in battle, with Karna at their head, the two heroic brothers rushed at them like two elephants rushing against a herd of hostile elephants.

sa: तत्कृते ह्यद्य पश्यामि शरतल्पगतं गुरुम्। धिगस्तु क्षात्रमाचारं धिगस्तु बलपौरुषम्॥
en: It is on his account, that I behold today my preceptor lying on an arrowy bed. Curse on the practices of the Kshatriyas and on my strength and manliness!

sa: तस्यैतद् वचनं श्रुत्वा हृष्टो दुर्योधनस्तदा। प्रतिगृह्याब्रवीद् वाक्यं भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः॥
en: Having heard those words of his, king Duryodhana was filled with delight; and surrounded as he was with his brothers welcoming the Rakshasa, he addressed these words to him.

sa: इत्युक्तो वासुदेवेन तथेत्युक्त्वा द्विजोत्तमः। विव्याध केशवं षष्ट्या नाराचैरर्जुनं त्रिभिः॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Vasudeva, the best of the twice-born persons said-"So be it." He also pierced Keshava with sixty arrows and penetrated Arjuna with three other shafts.

sa: कृष्ण उवाच मूर्जा निपत्य नियतस्तेजःसंनिचये ततः। परमं हर्षमागत्य भगवन्तमथाब्रुवम्॥
en: Krishna said Bending low my head with a controlled soul to that mass of energy and effulgence, I said to the great god, with a joyous heart, these words

sa: एवमेदतद् यदुश्रेष्ठं कृष्टं राजर्षिणा पुरा। शक्रेण चाभ्यनुज्ञातं ब्रह्माद्यैश्च सुरैस्तथा॥
en: Thus, O foremost of Yadu's race, that royal sage had, formerly cultivated this plain and Shakra had promised great merit to those that would give up their lives here.

sa: ततो हलहलाशब्द आसीद् यौधिष्ठिरे बले। जिघृक्षपि महासिंहे गजालामिव यूथपम्॥
en: Thereupon a very great confusion arose in the army of Yudhishthira which resembled that which prevails in a herd of elephants when the leader is attacked by a lion.

sa: तौ तु विक्षतसर्वाङ्गौ रुधिरौघपरिप्लुतौ॥ व्यभ्राजेतां यथा वारि स्रवन्तौ गैरिकाचलौ।
en: Covered with arrow-wounds all over the body and steeped in torrents of blood, they both looked beautiful like two hills of red chalk with rivulets flowing down their sides.

sa: रथाच्च स ध्वजः श्रीमान् नानारत्नविभूषितात्। पपात सहसा भूमौ विद्युज्जलधरादिव॥
en: And that beautiful standard, decked with diverse kinds of gems, suddenly felt down on the ground from the chariot, like lighting from the clouds shooting down on the earth.

sa: ततोऽहं तस्य शोकार्ता विरौमि भृशदुःखिता। अश्रूण्यावर्तयन्ती च नेत्राभ्यां करुणायती॥
en: O Vasava, look, he is unable to bear the burden. Therefore, afflicted with grief for his sake, I weep in agony; and tears of sorrow roll down my eyes.

sa: राजपुत्र्यास्तु गर्भः स मालव्या भरतर्षभ। व्यवर्धत तदा शुक्ले तारापतिरिवाम्बरे॥
